purpose: The ONE agent model table for hosted (GitHub Actions) and local (Orchestrator) agent runs: per provider, a pinned model per tier, a reasoning level per kind of work, the surfaces each agent runs on, and one fallback. Hosted runners read this file at run time from .workflows-lib (stranske/Workflows@workflows_ref). Orchestrator carries a byte-identical copy as TABLE_JSON in src/model_table.py; scripts/check_model_tables.py fails when the two disagree.
change_rule: Edit this file and merge it first, then copy it to stranske/Orchestrator in a paired PR with `python3 src/model_table.py --sync <this file>`. Codex execution_profiles in .github/agents/registry.yml must agree with work_kinds below (the drift check counts every disagreement).

routine.meaning: bounded edits, autofix, tests, review, codemods

hard.meaning: epics, cross-repo plans, runtime acceptance evidence

surface_model_evidence.hosted: Gemini API ids for the models the fleet runs and evaluates (Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon), the same ids config/verifier_shadow.json calls on GEMINI_API_KEY. The API id carries no effort rung; local agy ids do. Corrected 2026-11-09: the first hosted ids (gemini-3.5-flash, gemini-2.5-pro) were copied from the gemini-cli built-in model list, which lags the fleet.
surface_model_evidence.local: Gemini 4 Carbon (announced 2026-10-28, Google's frontier model above Argon) is the local frontier tier from 2026-11-10: agy 1.5.5 advertises gemini-4-carbon-{low,medium,high} and the Orchestrator's agy answered a live call on each. full stays Argon until Carbon has its own pilot record. Hosted keeps Argon: Carbon is not reported on the public Gemini API.

effort.note: local agy ids carry the effort rung in the model id; hosted gemini-cli has no effort flag
owner policy 2026-08-08: Composer only; never `auto` or a frontier model
single-model lane; the CLI config names the model
